QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Incognito
QuestInfo.0: Violetta has been kidnapped by the Black Viking. The Mushking is having a full-blown panic attack. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: The Mushking says they must figure out how to get onto the Viking ship. One option is to disguise as Vikings... Is there any way that could work?
QuestInfo.2: You stole some Viking gear and put it on, but as expected, you don't make a very convincing Viking.

0.0: What do we do now? Our princess got kidnapped again. Why, oh why must I reveal her beauty to the world? We must get her back. My heart breaks a little when I think about the terror she must be feeling right now.
0.1: We don't know anything about them. How can we even get on that ship. Can you help?

yes.0: I've given it some thought, and I think we should disguise ourselves and blend in with the Vikings to gather information. Bring me the #r#t4034110##k to start. We'll need about #r20#k of them for all our mushroom soldiers.

no.0: If something happens to my princess, I'm going to throw myself from the walls!

1.0: Did you get everything? Did you try them on? You might as well... since we don't have legs or anything.

default.0: We need #r20 #t4034110##k items to disguise ourselves as Vikings! It's the helmet that the #b#o3300104##k monsters wear!
